bookingOpens: Bookings only, preferably online through Zenchef from the restaurant's website. Dinner Tuesday to Saturday in two sittings, at 7pm and 9.30pm, plus lunch on Saturday.
cancellation: A card guarantee is taken for every booking. It can be changed or cancelled up to 48 hours ahead; after that the charge is €200 a person.
duration: A little under two hours. Guests at the first sitting are asked to leave by 9.15pm, and anyone more than 15 minutes late can't be served the whole menu.
